title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a J2EE Bad… (CVE-2026-80482)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 contain a vulnerability due to the use of System.exit() in J2EE code. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to cause a denial of service by terminating the application unexpectedly. The vulnerability has a low severity score and does not impact confidentiality or integrity.
